notes.title: Announcing the release of version 1.005
notes.notes:
Notice of FINAL FANTASY VII REMAKE INTERGRADE Update

[Updates]
Addressed an issue where the DualSense® Wireless Controller would not vibrate.

notes.title: Announcing the release of version 1.004
notes.notes:
Notice of FINAL FANTASY VII REMAKE INTERGRADE Update

[Updates]
・"New Game - Head Start" is now available. When selecting "NEW GAME" on the title screen, you have the option to start the game with the character level and inventory already powered-up. * There is an option to choose a regular "NEW GAME" as well.
　▼What will be powered-up
　-All characters will start at level 45 *You will have SP (skill points) equivalent to the amount you would've obtained when getting to level 45.
　-A number of materia at max level
　-Each character will have gear available toward the middle to the end of the story.
　-Each character will have accessories available toward the middle to the end of the story.
　-A number of items useful to you adventure.
　-50,000 gil in your posession
*You can choose this for both the main game as well as FF7R EPISODE INTERmission.

・"Fast-forward" during event scenes are now available. This will allow you to watch the scene without skipping over it, at 1.5 or 2.0 times speed.

notes.title: Version 1.002 Patch
notes.notes:
FINAL FANTASY VII REMAKE INTERGRADE has been updated to Version 1.002 on all platforms.

Please see the details below.

-The game now supports DualSense Edge™ wireless controllers and Bluetooth® connectivity for all compatible controllers, excluding certain vibration-related features.
-The issue for certain multiple-monitor configurations where the game's startup screen would not appear on the main display has been rectified.

Please note that, if you select "DualSense Edge Wireless Controller" or "Wireless Controller" on the "Controller Settings" submenu under "Options," you will not be able to take advantage of the DualSense Edge™ controller's added features such as vibration functionality. If you wish to use such features, please select "XInput Controller" instead.
